set.next_steps: P&S member vote (NCUA lists Nov 16, 2026; result not yet published); if approved, the merger takes effect Dec 1, 2026
set.notes: Firefighters CU announced the merger on Oct 1, 2026. The Utah Department of Financial Institutions and NCUA have approved it; P&S members began voting Oct 1 (NCUA lists the vote for Nov 16, 2026), and if they approve, the merger takes effect Dec 1, 2026. Firefighters CU members don't vote. The P&S branch keeps the P&S name while operations are combined, which is expected to take up to a year.

set.announced_figures: $3.2 billion credit union serving over 45,000 members, three branches
set.notes: OPEFCU announced a signed letter of intent to merge with F&A in a Sep 30, 2026 member letter. Members vote at a Nov 24, 2026 special meeting in Ontario. If approved, OPEFCU members become F&A members on Mar 1, 2027 and accounts convert Mar 29, 2027; the OPEFCU name sunsets. All OPEFCU employees, including its CEO, join F&A, and F&A's board continues.
